A '''stormtrooper squad''' was a unit of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Comprised of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] included at least five [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. One of the many squads that comprised the [[elite]] [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military's]] Stormtrooper Corps, the squad took their orders from [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

==Biography==
[[File:TakeHerAway-ANH.png|thumb|left|250px|Darth Vader orders the squad to take Organa away]]
{{Quote|We captured this one near the escape pods, ''Lord'' Vader|A trooper of the squad, to Darth Vader|<ref name="Droids6">[[Droids (1986) 6|''Droids'' (1986) 6]]</ref>}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of this [[Squad/Legends|squad]] served in the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="EP4" /> The squad was part of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], an elite stormtrooper [[Legion/Legends|legion]] unofficially known as Vader's Fist, under the direct command of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] enforcer.<ref name="BF2" /> The squad was assigned to the troop complement of the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']].<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref>

In 0 BBY, after [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents transmitted the stolen [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], a new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] to the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]], the ''Devastator'' pursued and captured it near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The squad was among the troopers, who [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|boarded]] the captured [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]]. Darth Vader ordered the [[Unidentified stormtrooper commander (Tantive IV)|assault commander]] to search for the plans and to bring him the passengers alive. After Organa was captured by Trooper [[DV-692]], the squad escorted her to the Vader.<ref name="EP4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The squad first appeared in the [[December]] [[1976]] [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']],<ref name="ANH novel">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref> ghostwritten by [[Alan Dean Foster]].<ref name="ANH novel SE">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]], [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|Special Edition]] foreword by [[George Lucas]]</ref> The Revised Fourth Draft of ''A New Hope'' also stated that ''"a squad of armored stormtroopers"'' escorted Organa to Vader.<ref name="BTM" />
